sentences.zh: 哦，原来是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, and was it, correct me if I'm wrong here, but I, for some reason, always thought that one of the major things that, for small brains like me,
sentences.zh: 是的，而且——如果我说错了请纠正我——但不知为什么，我一直以为对于像我这样脑容量小的人来说，其中一件最重要的事情，

sentences.en: that really was like, oh, because I remember computers used to, there was the coding thing, and then all of a sudden, one day, there were the, there was, I think it was Windows,
sentences.zh: 真的就是那种“哦”的感觉，因为我记得以前电脑需要写代码，然后突然有一天，就有了，我觉得那是Windows，

sentences.en: which was, it was just point and click stuff, and it was like, oh, this is a whole different thing.
sentences.zh: 也就是只需指点和点击的操作，当时就觉得，哇，这完全是另一回事了。

sentences.en: Was that not you, Mr. Gates?
sentences.zh: 难道不是这样吗，盖茨先生？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: So the idea of the graphics interface, where you use images, not just characters, that's pioneered at Xerox,
sentences.zh: 所以图形界面的概念，就是你用图像而不是仅仅用字符，最早是由施乐开创的，

sentences.en: which made a lot of money on copying machines, and they didn't manage to make a good product.
sentences.zh: 他们靠复印机赚了很多钱，但没能把它做成一款好的产品。

sentences.en: So it's actually Apple with the Macintosh and Microsoft with Windows that takes this idea of graphics interface and takes it to the masses.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上是苹果的Macintosh和微软的Windows采纳了图形界面的这个理念，并把它推向了大众。

sentences.en: And, you know, now everybody knows that's, you know, the way you use computers.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在每个人都知道，这就是使用电脑的方式。

sentences.en: You just point and click.
sentences.zh: 你只需要指点和点击。

sentences.en: But what we don't know is that underneath, what you're pointing on underneath that is a bunch of code that you're activating when you hit a click.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道的是，在表象之下，你点击的底层其实是一堆代码，当你点击时它们就被激活了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty, it's actually pretty complicated underneath, which is why we had to hire lots of smart engineers and write a lot of code.
sentences.zh: 对，底层的实际运作其实相当复杂，这就是为什么我们不得不雇佣大量聪明的工程师并编写大量代码。

sentences.en: But I will say, well, I kind of have two questions, which is, A, so you learn on these rudimentary huge computers that are only the government and, you know,
sentences.zh: 不过我想说，嗯，我其实有两个问题，一个是，A，所以你们是在那些只有政府和，你知道的，

sentences.en: educational institutions have, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 教育机构才拥有的这种简陋的大型计算机上学习的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So then, so you and Paul Allen realized that, okay, this is the future.
sentences.zh: 所以呢，你和保罗·艾伦意识到，好吧，这就是未来。

sentences.en: Are there people who can teach you how to do the stuff you did or did you have to figure a lot of that stuff out yourselves as you were going?
sentences.zh: 有没有人能教你们如何去做你们所做的事情，还是说你们在边做边学的过程中，大部分都得靠自己摸索？

sentences.en: We pretty much had to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上全靠自己摸索。

sentences.en: I mean, we did hire a few adults, you know, who knew things like finance and accounting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们确实雇了几位成年人，你知道的，他们懂一些财务和会计之类的知识。

sentences.en: But because we were at the forefront of a revolution, you know, this idea of, okay, how do you manage these people?
sentences.zh: 但因为我们处于一场革命的最前沿，你知道的，这种想法，好吧，你该如何管理这些人？

sentences.en: How do you price this stuff?
sentences.zh: 你如何为这些东西定价？

sentences.en: You know, we, and we decided we'd sell all over the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们，我们决定要在全世界进行销售。

sentences.en: So I have to build a team in Japan and Europe and deal with all the languages.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须在日本和欧洲建立团队，还要处理各种语言的问题。

sentences.en: I have to say it was super fun.
sentences.zh: 我必须得说，这真的超级有趣。

sentences.en: And because we were right, these computers got so popular, you know, we made enough money.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们的方向是对的，这些计算机变得如此受欢迎，你知道的，我们赚到了足够的钱。

sentences.en: We just kept hiring more and more people and eventually built Windows and Office, you know, which had Excel spreadsheet and Microsoft Word and those became.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不断地雇用越来越多的人，最终打造出了Windows和Office，你知道的，里面有Excel电子表格和微软Word，然后那些东西成为了……

sentences.en: I remember all that, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我都记得，对，对。

sentences.en: So by the late 90s, we are doing well.
sentences.zh: 所以到了90年代末，我们发展得很顺利。

sentences.en: And it's kind of a standard way that people use personal computers.
sentences.zh: 而且这也成了人们使用个人计算机的一种标准方式。

sentences.en: But sorry, Sean, if I just, just on that last little bit of the code stuff and you touched on that, so that Apple products came with your software built in.
sentences.zh: 但是抱歉，肖恩，如果我稍微……就刚才关于代码的那一小部分，你提到了这一点，就是苹果的产品自带了你们的软件。

sentences.en: And then you guys split and it became kind of like the, and forgive me for the comparison, it became like the VHS Betamax.
sentences.zh: 然后你们分道扬镳了，它有点像那个，请原谅我做这个比喻，它变得就像VHS和Betamax一样。

sentences.en: It was either or.
sentences.zh: 要么选这个，要么选那个。

sentences.en: It was like you either did this or you did that.
sentences.zh: 就好像你要么这样做，要么那样做。

sentences.en: Was there ever a discussion between you and Steve Jobs about, hey, let's continue in this partnership using your, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 你和史蒂夫·乔布斯之间有没有过这样的讨论：嘿，我们继续这种合作关系，使用你们的软件，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Did you guys, or was there a, was there a moment that you split?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有过，或者说有没有一个，有没有一个你们分手的时刻？

sentences.en: Because we're always pure software, the only competition is that they, Apple does its own operating system, which competes with Windows.
sentences.zh: 因为我们一直是纯粹的软件公司，唯一的竞争就是他们，苹果有自己的操作系统，这与Windows构成了竞争。

sentences.en: But we write software on the Macintosh.
sentences.zh: 但我们在麦金塔电脑上编写软件。

sentences.en: In fact, we had as many people as Steve Jobs did when he's doing the Macintosh because we do our word processor.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当史蒂夫·乔布斯在制作麦金塔电脑时，我们的人数和他一样多，因为我们要开发自己的文字处理软件。

sentences.en: We do our spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 我们要开发自己的电子表格软件。

sentences.en: And it was amazing because, you know, Steve did the Mac.
sentences.zh: 这太了不起了，因为，你知道的，史蒂夫做出了Mac。

sentences.en: That was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Then he leaves Apple.
sentences.zh: 然后他离开了苹果。

sentences.en: Apple's being very mismanaged.
sentences.zh: 苹果的管理非常混乱。

sentences.en: When he comes back, I reach a deal with him where we actually invest in Apple and commit to do our software.
sentences.zh: 当他回来时，我和他达成了一项协议，我们实际上对苹果进行了投资，并承诺开发我们的软件。

sentences.en: And then he runs that company so well that going from the verge of failure, it actually becomes the most valuable company in the world,
sentences.zh: 然后他把那家公司经营得如此出色，以至于从破产边缘，一跃成为了世界上最有价值的公司，

sentences.en: even slightly more valuable than Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 甚至比微软还要稍微值钱一点。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: So, we ended up working together.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们最终还是合作了。

sentences.en: And then in the last few years when he was sick, we got to reflect on our lives and talk to each other quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 然后在他生病的最后几年里，我们得以回顾自己的人生，并进行了很多交谈。

sentences.en: We were kind of competitors.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经算是竞争对手。

sentences.en: I mean, he would criticize Windows pretty brutally, but that's okay.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他会相当残酷地批评Windows，但没关系。

sentences.en: But his skill set, which was kind of design and user interface, he was not an engineer.
sentences.zh: 不过他的技能主要在于设计和用户界面，他不是一个工程师。

sentences.en: And so, you know, my skill is very much as an engineer.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我的技能很大程度上是一名工程师。

sentences.en: So, we appreciated each other, you know, of course.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们当然都很欣赏对方，你知道的。

sentences.en: Was there a lot of competition, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，当时竞争是不是很激烈？

sentences.en: Like, there had to be – when you're sitting in your garage or wherever you were with Paul, thinking, you know, designing this and coming up with this and all that stuff,
sentences.zh: 比如，肯定会是这样——当你和保罗坐在车库里或无论什么地方时，脑子里想着，你知道的，设计这个并想出这些点子以及所有这些事情，

sentences.en: back then you didn't have the – people didn't know what you were doing, right?
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，你们没有——人们不知道你们在做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Everybody knows what everybody's doing now.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都知道其他人在做什么。

sentences.en: And so, you didn't – you had this kind of secrecy so you could protect yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以你们没有——你们保持着这种神秘感，这样你们就能保护自己。

sentences.en: But as it got – as it grew and became the thing that it became, how do you protect yourself and how did you protect yourself from competitors?
sentences.zh: 但随着它的发展——随着它壮大并变成了后来的样子，你如何保护自己，你又是如何保护自己免受竞争对手侵害的？

sentences.en: And was Apple the only competitor?
sentences.zh: 苹果是唯一的竞争对手吗？

sentences.en: Because Microsoft wasn't about any one piece of software, not just Windows, not just Office.
sentences.zh: 因为微软不只是关于任何单一的软件，不仅仅是Windows，不仅仅是Office。

sentences.en: We were doing, you know, Xbox, which had games.
sentences.zh: 我们当时还在做，你知道的，Xbox，里面包含游戏。

sentences.en: We thought of ourselves as a software factory and we wanted to be faster than anyone else and have lower-priced software than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们自视为一个软件工厂，我们想要比任何人都快，并且拥有比任何人都便宜的软件。

sentences.en: And so, the other people doing software found it pretty intimidating that we moved at that speed.
sentences.zh: 因此，其他开发软件的人觉得我们的行动速度非常具有威慑力。

sentences.en: And that's why when Steve does the Macintosh, he comes to us and say, hey, are you willing to bet on this?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当史蒂夫打造 Macintosh 时，他找到我们说，嘿，你们愿意把宝押在这上面吗？

sentences.en: You know, can we work on this together?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们能一起合作这个吗？

sentences.en: It got quite competitive.
sentences.zh: 竞争变得相当激烈。

sentences.en: You know, eventually, other great companies like Google come along and they're also very good at hiring smart people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最终像谷歌这样伟大的其他公司也加入了进来，他们也非常擅长雇用聪明人。

sentences.en: And there's been room.
sentences.zh: 而且一直有发展空间。

sentences.en: You know, if you think of what are the most valuable companies in the world today, it's all these companies that ushered in this digital revolution.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你想想当今世界上最有价值的公司是什么，全都是那些开创了这场数字革命的公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was going to say, because now you have, instead of Google, Microsoft, and Apple, you have 200 AI companies now.
sentences.zh: 对，我正想说，因为现在除了谷歌、微软和苹果，你还能数出 200 家人工智能公司。

sentences.en: Because people see the future much more quickly now than they did then.
sentences.zh: 因为人们现在看到未来的速度比当年要快得多。

sentences.en: Sean, tell Mr. Gates, you're an Ask Jeeves guy, right?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，告诉盖茨先生，你是个 Ask Jeeves 的粉丝，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, that's been your whole...
sentences.zh: 就像，这一直是你整个……

sentences.en: Yeah, an Ask Jeeves.
sentences.zh: 对，Ask Jeeves 迷。

sentences.en: Mr. Gates, do you remember having conversations with Paul or Steve or any of your contemporaries at the time?
sentences.zh: 盖茨先生，你还记得当年与保罗、史蒂夫或任何同代人交谈的情景吗？

sentences.en: Do you remember sitting there having conversations with them and allow yourself the imagination for what the future could bring?
sentences.zh: 你还记得坐在那里与他们交谈，并发挥想象力去构想未来会带来什么吗？

sentences.en: And were there any things that were worrisome or exciting, like you hear about the conversations that are happening now regarding AI,
sentences.zh: 当时有没有什么事情让你感到担忧或兴奋，就像你听到现在关于人工智能的讨论一样，

sentences.en: where we're kind of on the doorstep of another big move?
sentences.zh: 我们正处于又一次重大变革的门槛上？

sentences.en: Do you remember having those concerns back then?
sentences.zh: 你还记得当年有过那些担忧吗？

sentences.en: Were there any?
sentences.zh: 有什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so the digital revolution with PCs and Internet, we thought of as very empowering.
sentences.zh: 对，所以对于以个人电脑和互联网为标志的数字革命，我们曾认为它极大地赋能了人们。

sentences.en: And so you could say we were kind of naive and thinking this was all good.
sentences.zh: 所以可以说我们有点天真，觉得这一切都是好的。

sentences.en: In fact, when we worried, we were worried about what we called the digital divide,
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我们感到担忧时，我们担心的是所谓的数字鸿沟，

sentences.en: that having access was so valuable that we should make sure that schools in the inner city and poor countries had the Internet and the PC.
sentences.zh: 即拥有触网渠道是如此宝贵，以至于我们应该确保内城学校和贫穷国家能够使用互联网和个人电脑。

sentences.en: It's only when social networking comes along that this kind of, oh, isn't it always for the good to give people new capabilities?
sentences.zh: 直到社交网络出现，这种“哦，赋予人们新能力难道不总是好事吗”的想法才改变了。

sentences.en: We realized, wow, you know, the social criticism, the waste of time, that in some ways we were playing to human weaknesses,
sentences.zh: 我们意识到，哇，你知道，社会批评、时间的浪费，在某种程度上我们是在利用人性的弱点，

sentences.en: that you seek out outrage and that kind of can drive people apart.
sentences.zh: 你寻找愤怒情绪，而那种东西会让人与人之间产生隔阂。

sentences.en: And now, you know, that we've seen that those advances aren't always good.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道的，既然我们已经看到这些进步并不总是带来好的结果。

sentences.en: Now with AI, which is far more powerful than social network, we're going, wow, how do we shape this thing to get the good, which is definitely there, but avoid the bad stuff?
sentences.zh: 现在有了比社交网络强大得多的人工智能，我们在想，哇，我们该如何塑造这个东西，去获取它好的一面（这绝对是存在的），同时避开不好的一面？

sentences.en: And it's a little bit scary right now.
sentences.zh: 现在这确实有点让人害怕。

sentences.en: Well, a little bit of trying to put the genie back in the bottle, A, unfortunately, with the social networks and also just with phones in general and their impacts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，试图让神灯重回神灯里有点难，A，不幸的是，社交网络以及手机本身及其影响都是如此。

sentences.en: You know, as a father of three boys under the age of 16 and younger, I would ask you, and I know your kids are a little bit older, and look,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，作为三个 16 岁及以下男孩的父亲，我想问你，我知道你的孩子稍微大一点，而且听着，

sentences.en: I don't like answering hypothetical questions myself, but I'm going to ask you a hypothetical, which is, and feel free to not answer it, if your kids were teenagers again,
sentences.zh: 我自己也不喜欢回答假设性问题，但我打算问你一个假设性问题，也就是，你可以不回答，如果你的孩子再次成为青少年，

sentences.en: if they were adolescents, if they were 11, 12, 13, 14, would you let them have access to social media?
sentences.zh: 如果他们是青春期少年，如果他们 11、12、13、14 岁，你会让他们接触社交媒体吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, my youngest, I stopped her from having a cell phone until she was 14, and she was quite upset because the other kids had access.
sentences.zh: 对，我的小女儿，我直到她 14 岁才给她买手机，她当时非常沮丧，因为其他孩子都可以用。

sentences.en: It works a lot better if groups of parents or even the school come in and saying, hey, during the school day, this is pretty distracting.
sentences.zh: 如果有家长群体甚至学校介入并说，嘿，在学校期间，这非常分散注意力，效果会好得多。

sentences.en: And Australia is now trying to pass a set of rules.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚现在正试图通过一套规则。

sentences.en: You know, there's a book by Jonathan Haidt called The Anxious Generation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，乔纳森·海特写过一本书叫《焦虑的一代》。

sentences.en: Yeah, we've read it.
sentences.zh: 对，我们读过。

sentences.en: I've read it.
sentences.zh: 我读过。

sentences.en: Okay, good, good.
sentences.zh: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: You know, and his point that we're kind of overprotecting kids in the real world and underprotecting them in the digital world, I think he's got a super good point there,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他的观点是我们在现实世界中对孩子过度保护，而在数字世界中保护不足，我觉得他这个观点讲得超级好，

sentences.en: and we've got to step up on that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在这方面加强力度。

sentences.en: I took his advice, and I said to my boys, to my teenage boys, I said,
sentences.zh: 我听取了他的建议，我对我的男孩们、我的青少年儿子们说，

sentences.en: I will give you a lot of freedoms in the real world that are commensurate with your reduction in your time in the digital world.
sentences.zh: 我将赋予你在现实世界中更多的自由，这与你减少在数字世界中的时间相称。

sentences.en: And I will give you much more leeway to do stuff and spend time in real time and give you a later curfew on the weekend, you know, sort of 1130, if you will, or whatever that is,
sentences.zh: 我会给你更多的空间去做事，花时间进行实时社交，并在周末给你一个更晚的门禁时间，你知道的，比如晚上 11 点半之类的，不管具体是几点，

sentences.en: if you guys, if I see a market reduction in your time online.
sentences.zh: 前提是你们、如果我看到你们上网时间明显减少的话。

sentences.en: But what I dream about, this is what I'm getting to, what I dream of is six months of no social media on this planet.
sentences.zh: 但我梦寐以求的是——这就是我要说的——我梦想着这个星球上有六个月没有社交媒体。

sentences.en: And what would that do in a sort of a social, in a reset?
sentences.zh: 那会在某种社会层面上、在一个重置中产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Imagine a world where we didn't have that.
sentences.zh: 想象一个没有那种东西的世界。

sentences.en: I personally think that we would be in a much better place.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为，我们的处境会好得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, when you see how polarized we are, and that, you know, even I, if there's some article criticizing somebody I don't like, I'm like, oh, yeah,
sentences.zh: 对啊，你看我们现在的分化有多严重，甚至连我自己，看到有文章批评我不喜欢的人时，我都会觉得，哦，对啊，

sentences.en: I want to be outraged against the people I think have shortcomings.
sentences.zh: 我想对那些我认为有缺点的人进行谴责。

sentences.en: And so, you know, you want an algorithm that brings us together, and, you know, maybe a moratorium would help us get there.
sentences.zh: 所以你看，你需要一个能把我们凝聚在一起的算法，也许暂停一下能帮我们实现这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we will be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: My, you know, as a kid who grew up in the 70s, as a Gen Xer, you know,
sentences.zh: 作为一个在70年代长大的孩子，作为一个X世代，你知道，

sentences.en: your rise and your significance in the world coincided with sort of my teenage years and understanding that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 你在世界上的崛起和重要性，恰好伴随着我的青少年时期，以及我对这类事情的理解。

sentences.en: And it felt like the first time that we had things like the, you know, the fortune list or the Forbes or the richest people in the world.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们第一次有了财富榜、福布斯或者世界首富这样的概念。

sentences.en: And your name was in and out of the top of that for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 而且很多很多年里，你的名字一直在这个榜单的顶端上下浮动。

sentences.en: And I can't imagine just how absurd that must be on a certain level.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象在某种程度上这有多么荒谬。

sentences.en: Did you have those moments of, like, not even pinch me, but of, like, is this me?
sentences.zh: 你有没有过那种感觉，甚至不是“掐我一下”，而是“这真的是我吗”？

sentences.en: It feels almost abstract.
sentences.zh: 感觉几乎很不真实。

sentences.en: How bizarre.
sentences.zh: 太离奇了。

sentences.en: Did you have that at all?
sentences.zh: 你完全没有这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Or just leave me alone?
sentences.zh: 还是说只想让我一个人静静？

sentences.en: Well, it's definitely wild.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这绝对是很疯狂的。

sentences.en: You know, at a young age, you know, I was in my 30s when I become the richest person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在很年轻的时候，我30多岁就成了世界首富。

sentences.en: And my parents, fortunately, you know, their values helped anchor me.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我父母的价值观帮我稳住了阵脚。

sentences.en: And they were always saying, okay, you know, to whom much is given, much is expected.
sentences.zh: 他们总是说，能力越大，责任越大。

sentences.en: You know, so I did start in my 40s to really study philanthropy, you know, Rockefeller, Carnegie.
sentences.zh: 所以我在40多岁时开始真正研究慈善事业，比如洛克菲勒、卡耐基。

sentences.en: What had they done?
sentences.zh: 他们都做了些什么？

sentences.en: And try and figure out, you know, could I be as careful about giving it back?
sentences.zh: 并试图弄清楚，你知道，我在回馈社会时能否做到同样谨慎？

sentences.en: And then in my 50s, I retired from Microsoft and moved over to do foundation work full time.
sentences.zh: 然后在我50多岁时，我从微软退休，转而全职从事基金会的工作。

sentences.en: But, yes, it's bizarre.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，这确实很离奇。

sentences.en: Having close friends who really know you, who can laugh about your success, I think, you know, does help keep you grounded.
sentences.zh: 拥有真正了解你、能对你的成功付诸一笑的密友，我认为确实有助于让你保持脚踏实地。

sentences.en: That transition to philanthropy, I'm sure there are many parts of it that are even more complicated than your life beforehand.
sentences.zh: 转向慈善事业那个转变，我确信其中有很多部分比你之前的生活要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Many, many challenges.
sentences.zh: 有非常多的挑战。

sentences.en: Can you speak about those?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈这些吗？

sentences.en: I'm sure there's a lot of it that is much more enjoyable, too.
sentences.zh: 我确信其中也有很多让人愉快得多的部分。

sentences.en: Probably most of it.
sentences.zh: 可能大部分都是如此。

sentences.en: How is that feeling, that transition?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉如何，那个转变？

sentences.en: Well, I loved being an individual contributor in my 20s and then managing Microsoft in my 30s where, you know, you're just very hands-on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我20多岁时很喜欢做个人贡献者，30多岁时管理微软，那时你事事亲力亲为。

sentences.en: And you can say, my product is selling well or this one is not.
sentences.zh: 你可以说，我的产品卖得很好，或者这个卖得不好。

sentences.en: How do we fix that?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么解决？

sentences.en: And so it's a real switch, you know, where you're not having that immediate market feedback to go and say, hey, why do children die?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个真正的转变，你不再有那种即时的市场反馈去说，嘿，为什么孩子们会死？

sentences.en: How many children die?
sentences.zh: 有多少孩子死亡？

sentences.en: Can we reduce that?
sentences.zh: 我们能减少这个数字吗？

sentences.en: And then I had to learn about poor countries and vaccines.
sentences.zh: 然后我不得不了解贫穷国家和疫苗。

sentences.en: But I have to say it's been, you know, as fulfilling, you know, in the turn of the century, we have 10 million children dying every year.
sentences.zh: 但我必须说，这同样令人满足，你知道，在世纪之交时，我们每年有1000万儿童死亡。

sentences.en: And because we got out new vaccines and worked with partners, that's now down below 5 million a year.
sentences.zh: 因为我们推出了新疫苗并与合作伙伴合作，现在这个数字已经降到每年500万以下。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And if we keep doing our work well, including governments caring about poor countries, we can cut that in half again to 2.5 million.
sentences.zh: 如果我们继续做好我们的工作，包括让各国政府关心贫穷国家，我们可以把这个数字再减半，降到250万。

sentences.en: Sorry, have you found a way to make it an attractive idea for countries to come on and partner with you that goes beyond just the obvious ethical and moral pull of it?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，除了显而易见的伦理和道德感召力之外，你有没有找到一种方法，让国家参与进来并与你们合作成为一个有吸引力的主意？

sentences.en: Is there a GDP component that you can dangle in front of some of these more capitalistic-minded countries that get them to the table a little bit better?
sentences.zh: 有没有一个GDP因素，你可以把它在其中一些更具资本主义思维的国家面前晃一晃，让他们更好地坐到谈判桌前？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a super good point is, you know, we, of course, the moral argument of the golden rule, you know, helping people everywhere is our strongest argument.
sentences.zh: 对，这真的是个好点子，你知道，我们当然，黄金法则的道德论证，也就是帮助各地的人们，是我们最有力的论点。

sentences.en: But that alone isn't going to get us there.
sentences.zh: 但仅凭这一点是无法让我们达成目标的。

sentences.en: You know, we had some of the generals in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国陆军的一些将军曾说，嘿，如果你不帮这些国家，那我们就得去打仗，你知道，你们就得增加预算。

sentences.en: Army saying, hey, if you don't help these countries out, then we'll have to go to war and, you know, you'll have to increase our budget.
sentences.zh: 如果你不帮这些国家，那我们就得去打仗，你知道，你们就得增加预算。

sentences.en: So that the foreign aid budget, by creating stability, it avoids the awful war.
sentences.zh: 因此，外援预算通过创造稳定，避免了可怕的战争。

sentences.en: And also, you know, if you lift people up economically, like Asia today, you know, buys a lot of American stuff, movies, drugs, jets, software, you know, you name it.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，如果你在经济上扶持人们，就像今天的亚洲，你知道，购买很多美国的东西、电影、药品、喷气式飞机、软件，你知道，应有尽有。

sentences.en: So our mutual success, you know, has been amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的共同成功，你知道，是非常惊人的。

sentences.en: You know, the two countries we defeat in World War II, we're generous enough to them that they become the second and third biggest economy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在二战中击败的两个国家，我们对他们足够慷慨，以至于他们成为了第二和第三大经济体。

sentences.en: And we engage in mutually beneficial trade.
sentences.zh: 并且我们进行互利共赢的贸易。

sentences.en: You know, Japan shows us how to make quality products.
sentences.zh: 你知道，日本向我们展示了如何制造优质产品。

sentences.en: And now we want to extend that, you know, and get, you know, Asia's doing well.
sentences.zh: 现在我们想要将其推广，你知道，让，你知道，亚洲发展得很好。

sentences.en: India's getting rich and eventually they don't need aid if you help them out.
sentences.zh: 印度正在变得富裕，最终如果你帮助他们，他们就不需要援助了。

sentences.en: And so you only have mostly countries in Africa that still really deserve this kind of support.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上只有非洲国家仍然真正需要这种支持。

sentences.en: Are you finding that you're having the same kind of messaging language success as you try to encourage them to come along with environmental adjustments as well,
sentences.zh: 你是否发现，当你试图鼓励他们配合环境调整时，你在传达信息和语言上也取得了同样的成功，

sentences.en: that it's mutually beneficial from a business standpoint, etc.?
sentences.zh: 即从商业角度来看这是互利互惠的，等等？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, you know, environmentally, a lot of these poor countries are very beautiful and, you know, we all have to deal with climate change.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在环境方面，许多这些贫穷国家非常美丽，而且，你知道，我们都需要应对气候变化。

sentences.en: Sadly, it's these African countries that didn't contribute to that problem at all because they're outdoor farmers near the equator.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，正是这些非洲国家根本没有对这个问题造成影响，因为他们是赤道附近的户外农民。

sentences.en: They're the ones that are suffering the moSt.
sentences.zh: 他们反而是受害最深的。

sentences.en: The countries we need to really change their emissions are these middle-income countries.
sentences.zh: 我们需要真正改变其排放量的国家是这些中等收入国家。

sentences.en: So China, Brazil, now India.
sentences.zh: 也就是中国、巴西，现在还有印度。

sentences.en: And they expect us to help them by inventing really inexpensive ways to go green.
sentences.zh: 他们期望我们通过发明真正便宜的绿色发展方法来帮助他们。

sentences.en: And so the biggest hope for the environmental stuff is innovation.
sentences.zh: 因此，环保方面最大的希望在于创新。

sentences.en: If the green stuff is really expensive, even the rich countries are kind of saying, hey, don't make me buy an electric car if it costs more.
sentences.zh: 如果绿色技术真的很昂贵，甚至连富裕国家也会说，嘿，如果价格更高，就别让我买电动汽车。

sentences.en: Don't make me buy an electric heat pump.
sentences.zh: 别让我买电动热泵。

sentences.en: And so, you know, it's going to have to be all of us saying we're in this together, it's one planet, but also a lot of innovation because nobody can agree if it's expensive,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这将需要我们所有人都说我们休戚与共，这是一个地球，但同时也需要大量的创新，因为如果价格昂贵，没有人能就是否需要达成一致，

sentences.en: who should pay for it.
sentences.zh: 谁来为此买单。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A friend of mine who's sort of a friend of ours, a friend of the show, Willie, our buddy, he mentioned that there,
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友，某种程度上也是我们的朋友，节目的朋友，威利，我们的老兄，他提到，

sentences.en: with this big round of deregulation that supposedly is on its way,
sentences.zh: 随着这次据称即将到来的大规模放松管制，

sentences.en: that there may be a good spin to it in that the amount of innovation that is needed to really make a big move in an environment,
sentences.zh: 这里面可能有一个很好的说辞，即要在环境中实现重大变革所需的创新量，

sentences.en: a part of that, it's necessary for private to be spending money there as well as just federal money.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分是必要的，不仅需要联邦资金，也需要私营部门在其中投入资金。

sentences.en: And so by deregulating, you give those companies more money to spend in R&D for these environmental things.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过放松管制，你可以给这些公司更多的资金，用于这些环保事业的研发。

sentences.en: Is that just spin for the business sector?
sentences.zh: 这只是商业部门的宣传话术吗？

sentences.en: And I'll let you guess what business he's in.
sentences.zh: 我让你猜猜他是做什么生意的。

sentences.en: He's a great guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个极好的人。

sentences.en: What do we think about that?
sentences.zh: 我们对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Is that spin or is there some validity to that?
sentences.zh: 这是宣传话术，还是有一定道理？

sentences.en: No, there's definitely some validity.
sentences.zh: 不，这绝对有一定道理。

sentences.en: For example, if you want to build an electricity transmission line, you often have to go through almost a decade of approvals.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你想建造一条输电线路，你通常必须经历近十年的审批过程。

sentences.en: And of course, that line, if anybody blocks it, then it doesn't work at all.
sentences.zh: 当然，那条线路，如果任何人阻止它，那就完全行不通了。

sentences.en: And so we need to have more collective action as we try and change, you know, move away from coal, electricity to other things,
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们试图改变、你知道，从煤炭、电力转向其他事物时，我们需要采取更多的集体行动，

sentences.en: which is sun and wind and nuclear and a variety of things.
sentences.zh: 也就是太阳能、风能、核能以及各种其他能源。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We don't want to get rid of all the regulations because part of the reason the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们并不想废除所有的规章制度，因为美国之所以如此美丽的部分原因在于，

sentences.en: is so beautiful,
sentences.zh: 我们保护了土地，我们水域的清洁程度超过了任何其他国家。

sentences.en: we preserve lands, we've cleaned up our waters better than any other country.
sentences.zh: 我们保护了土地，我们水域的清洁程度超过了任何其他国家。

sentences.en: But it is absolutely fair to say that many of these environmental reviews are delaying projects that we need in order to solve climate change.
sentences.zh: 但绝对可以公平地说，许多这类环境审查正在拖延我们解决气候变化所必需的项目。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So government could get out of the way a little bit because we've got to work fast, right?
sentences.zh: 所以政府可以稍微让开一点，因为我们必须快速行动，对吧？

sentences.en: But not completely?
sentences.zh: 但不是完全不管？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we're going to have to strike that balance.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将不得不找到那个平衡点。

sentences.en: Well, it's so hard not to be cynical when you have things like, and you were just touching on the idea, Jason,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你遇到诸如此类的事情时，很难不变成愤世嫉俗的人，而你刚才正触及这个想法，杰森，

sentences.en: it was partly baked into your question, which is this, that, yeah, of course there is, you know,
sentences.zh: 你的问题里其实已经包含了部分答案，那就是，当然是有的，你知道的，

sentences.en: what you call the ethical or moral pull, but it always comes down to economics, right?
sentences.zh: 也就是你所说的伦理或道德驱动力，但归根结底还是经济问题，对吧？

sentences.en: It's always, sadly, it's the driver of everything.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，这永远是一切背后的驱动力。

sentences.en: It's like when the government went to war on the cigarette companies, it wasn't because they wanted us to stop smoking,
sentences.zh: 就像当年政府向烟草公司宣战一样，并不是因为他们想让我们戒烟，

sentences.zh: 不幸的是，是因为他们不想为生病的人支付医疗费用。

sentences.zh: 这必须是一个双赢的局面。

sentences.en: Ultimately, otherwise they wouldn't, they couldn't care less.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，否则他们才不会管，他们才不在乎呢。

sentences.zh: 而且我认为美国存在一个社会问题，盖茨先生，我还没向你透露过，

sentences.zh: 我出生在加拿大。

sentences.en: So, and I'm sorry to drop it on you like that.
sentences.zh: 所以，很抱歉突然向你抛出这个。

sentences.en: We had a reveal party earlier.
sentences.zh: 我们之前举办了一个揭晓派对。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think that there is a societal, there are some societal issues,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我认为存在一个社会问题，有一些社会问题，

sentences.en: and I am American as well, and I've lived here for a number of years, and I love this country.
sentences.zh: 而且我也是美国人，我在这里住了好多年，我热爱这个国家。

sentences.en: I truly, truly do, and my children are all American.
sentences.zh: 我是真的、真的很热爱，而且我的孩子们全都是美国人。

sentences.en: It's an incredible experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一段不可思议的经历。

sentences.en: And, but I do think that there are some issues societally in this country that I've, that come up,
sentences.zh: 而且，但我确实认为这个国家在社会层面上存在一些我所经历过、并浮现出来的问题，

sentences.en: that have to do with, that, that, unfortunately, and I know that, look, I'm not naive,
sentences.zh: 这些问题与……不幸的是，我知道，看，我并不天真，

sentences.en: but unfortunately a lot of things in this country are driven by people wanting to, what's theirs,
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，这个国家的许多事情都是由人们想要守护属于自己的东西所驱动的，

sentences.en: and there isn't this idea that we're only as strong as our weakest link.
sentences.zh: 而我们并没有这种“我们的强大程度取决于我们最薄弱的环节”的观念。

sentences.en: Like, it just, and if anything, it keeps getting reinforced in different ways in elections, et cetera,
sentences.zh: 就像，它只是……如果说有什么不同的话，那就是它在选举等各种事情中不断以不同的方式得到强化，

sentences.en: in the way that you look at, California should have buried power lines.
sentences.zh: 从你所看到的事情来看，比如加利福尼亚州本该把电线埋入地下。

sentences.en: There's no question about it, but nobody wants to pay for that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问本该如此，但没有人愿意为这种事买单。

sentences.en: And so, there are all sorts of things like that, and people just won't do it.
sentences.zh: 所以，诸如此类的事情各种各样，而人们就是不肯去做。

sentences.en: And I don't know how we can change minds in this country, but it is strange.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们该如何改变这个国家的观念，但这一切真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: And people will vote against their self-interest in this country in ways that are staggering.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，人们会以令人瞠目结舌的方式投票反对自身的利益。

sentences.en: And, and I, I'm, I'm giving you all these big picture things because I, I imagine, Mr. Gates,
sentences.zh: 而且，而且我，我正在，我正在把所有这些宏观的事情告诉你，因为我，我想象，盖茨先生，

sentences.zh: 这些正是你会去思考的那类事情，因为你一直在处理宏观层面的事务。

sentences.en: Am I right with that?
sentences.zh: 我这样说对吗？

sentences.en: No, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 不，完全正确。

sentences.en: The, you know, I, when I think about the health system or climate, you know, we've got to solve these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 你懂得，我，当我考虑医疗系统或气候问题时，你知道，我们必须解决这些问题。

sentences.en: You know, we saw that when we weren't ready for the pandemic, millions of people died who, who shouldn't have died.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们在大流行来临时毫无准备时，我们看到了这一点，数百万本不该死的人却死了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 请继续，肖恩。

sentences.zh: 我刚才只是想说，我喜欢，我喜欢所有这些……谈到医学，我喜欢你正在做的所有医学相关的事情。

sentences.en: It is a great name.
sentences.zh: 这真的是个好名字。

sentences.en: Hey, Trey, we can call you Trey?
sentences.zh: 嘿，特雷，我们可以叫你特雷吗？

sentences.en: Trey.
sentences.zh: 特雷。

sentences.en: That was my nickname.
sentences.zh: 那是我的昵称。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: My family still calls me that because my dad was Bill.
sentences.zh: 我的家人至今仍这么叫我，因为我爸爸叫比尔。

sentences.en: Wait, why, where'd you get Trey?
sentences.zh: 等等，为什么，你的“特雷”是怎么来的？

sentences.en: The third.
sentences.zh: 老三（第三世）。

sentences.en: So, hey, Trey, I love all the medical things you're involved with, and so what's your favorite one you're working on, and how has all,
sentences.zh: 所以，嘿，特雷，我热爱你参与的所有医疗相关事务，那么你正在从事的项目中你最喜欢哪一个，还有这一切，

sentences.en: being around all the innovation of this medical world that you're involved with changed the way you live your life, whether that's food, you know, diet,
sentences.zh: 身处你所涉足的这个医疗世界的种种创新之中，是如何改变你的生活方式的，不管是食物，你知道的，饮食，

sentences.en: or whatever it is that we don't know about?
sentences.zh: 还是其他我们所不知道的东西？

sentences.en: We're learning a lot, you know, we've learned that sleep is very important on nutrition, you know, we're still kind of confused about other than eating too many calories,
sentences.zh: 我们正在了解很多，你知道的，我们了解到睡眠对营养非常重要，你知道的，除了吃太多卡路里之外，我们对其他方面仍然有点困惑，

sentences.en: what counts, you know, the work of our foundation is very focused on the diseases that are still huge in poor countries.
sentences.zh: 到底什么才算数，你知道的，我们基金会的工作非常专注于那些在贫困国家依然严重的疾病。

sentences.en: So, HIV, malaria, you know, we literally still have polio out there, even though we got rid of it in the U.S., and kids aren't dying and being paralyzed,
sentences.zh: 所以，艾滋病、疟疾，你知道的，我们在现实中甚至还有小儿麻痹症，尽管我们在美国已经消灭了它，孩子们不再因此死亡和瘫痪，

sentences.en: but we're down to just a few countries, and so the only disease we've ever gotten rid of is smallpox, and now polio is very close to being the second on that liSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在只剩几个国家有了，所以我们曾经彻底消灭的唯一疾病是天花，而现在小儿麻痹症非常接近成为名单上的第二个。

sentences.en: So, I put a lot of effort into that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在上面投入了大量的精力。

sentences.en: With HIV, you've got a million Americans living with it, 40 million worldwide.
sentences.zh: 就艾滋病而言，有一百万美国人感染，全球有四千万。

sentences.en: We'd like to make it so we can actually cure it, rather than you having to take medicine the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 我们希望能做到真正治愈它，而不是让你余生都得吃药。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so, we're making good progress on that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们在那方面取得了很好的进展。

sentences.en: Is there any truth to the fact, like, because I hear, like, they actually, you know, you hear these conspiracies that there actually is a cure for HIV,
sentences.zh: 这其中有什么真实性吗，比如，因为我听说，像他们实际上，你知道的，你会听到这些阴谋论，说其实有治疗艾滋病的药，

sentences.en: or there is a cure for all these things,
sentences.zh: 或者有治疗所有这些疾病的药，

sentences.en: but they suppress it because there's too much money in pharmaceuticals.
sentences.zh: 但他们把它隐瞒了，因为医药行业的利益太大了。

sentences.en: No, I wish that was true, because then I would take the cure and, you know.
sentences.zh: 不，我希望那是真的，因为那样的话我就会去接受治疗，然后，你知道的。

sentences.en: Give it to everybody.
sentences.zh: 把它分发给所有人。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: Do you know about this?
sentences.zh: 你知道这个吗？

sentences.en: Gosh, now it just occurred to me, now that you're here, I'm going to call you Bill as well, if that's okay.
sentences.zh: 天哪，现在我突然想到，既然你在这儿，如果可以的话，我也要叫你比尔。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Bill, I know, because I've been reading online, and a lot of people from their basement say that you're putting chips in our brain, which is amazing.
sentences.zh: 比尔，我知道，因为我在网上看到过，很多在地下室里的人说你在我们的脑子里植入芯片，这太神奇了。

sentences.en: I love, I love when people, when I hear that, and I always, my answer to that is always, to what end?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢，我喜欢当人们，当我听到这个的时候，我总是，我对这个的回答总是，为了达到什么目的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 对，我知道。

sentences.en: Like, why do you want to say, why does he want to say my head?
sentences.zh: 比如，你为什么想说，他为什么想窥探我的脑子？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: Anytime I hear somebody say, the government, I'm like, all right, we're done.
sentences.zh: 每当我听到有人说，政府怎么怎么样，我就想，好吧，我们聊不下去了。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: But, do you, do you hear any of that?
sentences.zh: 但是，你，你听到过这些说法吗？

sentences.en: Does it make its way to you?
sentences.zh: 这些传言会传到你那里吗？

sentences.en: Do you laugh about it sometimes?
sentences.zh: 你有时会对此付之一笑吗？

sentences.en: Does it alarm you when you hear these people saying, Bill Gates is trying to put a chip into everybody's brain?
sentences.zh: 当你听到这些人说比尔·盖茨正试图在每个人的大脑里植入芯片时，你会感到惊慌吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I've had people come up to me on the street and yell at me that, you know, why am I tracking them?
sentences.zh: 对，呃，曾有人在街上走到我面前，冲我大喊，你知道的，问我为什么要追踪他们？

sentences.en: And I look at them like, but why are you?
sentences.zh: 而我看着他们心想，但你为什么要让我追踪？

sentences.en: What am I going to do with that information?
sentences.zh: 我拿那种信息能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, so you do have to laugh about it,
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以你确实得对此一笑置之，

sentences.en: but it's also at the same time tragic that millions who would have been saved by the COVID vaccine stayed away from it because of all the online misinformation that they were faced with.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时也很悲剧，因为数百万本可以因新冠疫苗而获救的人，却因为他们所面临的各种网络虚假信息而对其避之不及。

sentences.en: But then, you know, whenever you get a pandemic saying, oh, there must be some evil genius behind this.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，你知道的，每当发生大流行病时，人们就会说，哦，这背后一定有什么邪恶的天才。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's not very adaptive.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一种很有适应性的思维。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, and we're not really ready for the next pandemic, which will come.
sentences.zh: 你知道，而且我们其实并没有为下一次终将到来的大流行病做好准备。

sentences.en: Hard to say when it's going to come.
sentences.zh: 很难说它什么时候会来。

sentences.en: But, you know, I thought that would make vaccines more popular.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我本以为这会使疫苗更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so there's some work to be done here.
sentences.zh: 所以这里还有一些工作要做。

sentences.en: So, Bill, with all the AI stuff that's being talked about, and I'm sure if you're like me, you get a little kind of tune out a bit because there's so much of it.
sentences.zh: 那么，比尔，关于现在人们都在讨论的人工智能，我敢肯定如果你和我一样，你多少会有点听腻了，因为这方面的讨论太多了。

sentences.en: But is there – well, I'm sure there's many parts.
sentences.zh: 但有没有——嗯，我确信有很多方面。

sentences.en: What's your – what's the most promising use of AI that you can see coming soon?
sentences.zh: 你认为——你能看到即将到来的最有用的人工智能应用是什么？

sentences.en: I'm sure it's going to fix a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 我确信这会解决很多问题。

sentences.en: But is there something that might be on the doorstep that you can talk about?
sentences.zh: 但有没有什么迫在眉睫的事情是你可以谈论的呢？

sentences.en: Well, I'd say the most promising work is health and education.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为最有前景的工作是在健康和教育领域。

sentences.en: Even today, if you get like a set of blood tests back or an MRI test back, you know, or you get a confusing medical bill, you really should stick it in the AI and say,
sentences.zh: 即使在今天，如果你拿回了一套血液检测报告或核磁共振报告，你知道，或者收到了一张令人困惑的医疗账单，你真的应该把它输入给AI，然后说：

sentences.en: explain this to me like a sixth grader because it is so good at doing that.
sentences.zh: 像对六年级学生一样向我解释这个，因为它在这方面真的很擅长。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And so –
sentences.zh: 所以——

sentences.en: God, I'd use it all the time.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我会一直使用它。

sentences.en: Helping people with medical things and then in education, having a personal tutor that gets what you're confused about the level that you're at and knows how to encourage you,
sentences.zh: 在医疗方面帮助人们，然后在教育方面，拥有一个私人导师，他能理解你困惑的地方、你所处的水平，并知道如何鼓励你，

sentences.en: you know, whether it's in math or writing papers and, you know, this – it's early days and it's being rolled out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论是在数学还是写论文方面，而且你知道，这个——现在还处于早期阶段，正在逐步推出。

sentences.en: And this will not only be profound for the United States, but in Africa, you know, we're – we have fewer teachers and doctors than anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 这不仅对美国意义深远，而且在非洲，你知道，我们——我们的老师和医生比世界上任何地方都少。

sentences.en: And so a chance for us to give them, you know, access to the kind of health that we take for granted.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个让我们给他们提供，你知道的，我们认为理所应当的那种健康服务机会。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: AI, in those two domains, we should push forward, you know, get the accuracy up and, you know, really surprise people by improving the health system a lot.
sentences.zh: 在着两个领域，我们应该推进AI，你知道，提高准确率，并且，你知道，通过极大地改善医疗系统来真正让人们惊叹。

sentences.en: And this question is coming from a person who has no idea how research and development happens in medical science.
sentences.zh: 这个问题来自一个对医学科学中的研发是如何进行一无所知的人。

sentences.en: But I think that you get an idea, then you got to run it through a modeling thing and you got to test it all out.
sentences.zh: 但我想你大概有个概念，然后你得把它放到一个建模的东西里去运行，你得把所有东西都测试一遍。

sentences.en: But am I right in assuming that AI can make this much,
sentences.zh: 但我这样假设对吗：AI能让这个过程变得非常、

sentences.en: much faster such that we can track down maybe what the right equation is to fix cancer or any other of these incredibly damaging things?
sentences.zh: 非常快，以至于我们可以追踪到也许什么是解决癌症或其他任何这些极具破坏性事情的正确方程式？

sentences.en: That maybe that the process of elimination can happen much faster where we can reasonably expect to have some cures for some of these uncurable things perhaps in our lifetime?
sentences.zh: 也许排除法的过程可以发生得更快，使我们有理由期望在我们的有生之年，对其中一些不治之症找到一些治愈方法？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, medicine has made a lot of progress.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，医学已经取得了很大的进展。

sentences.en: I mean, heart disease is way down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，心脏病发病率大幅下降。

sentences.en: You know, cancer, we have a lot of things in the pipeline.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于癌症，我们有很多正在研发的项目。

sentences.en: But AI is going to accelerate all of that.
sentences.zh: 但AI将加速所有这些进程。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: You know, I work in Alzheimer's and there's some great tools coming along because nobody should want to have that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从事阿茨海默症研究，有一些很棒的工具正在涌现，因为没有人会想得这种病。

sentences.en: And even, you know, with HIV, this idea of the cure, the fact we can get it out maybe in four years instead of eight, we'll use AI to help accelerate that.
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道，对于艾滋病，这种治愈的想法，我们可能在四年而不是八年内就能攻克它，我们将利用AI来帮助加速这一进程。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Your mom was really influential with you for sort of planting this early seed of philanthropy and giving back and using what you're given in the right way.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈对你影响很大，她为你埋下了慈善和回馈的早期种子，并教导你以正确的方式运用你所拥有的一切。

sentences.en: Is that correct?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to speak about that at all?
sentences.zh: 你愿意谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: I mean, when you see your parents behave, that's more influential than what your parents say.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你看到父母的行为时，这比你父母说的话更有影响力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so they, you know, volunteered in the community.
sentences.zh: 所以他们，你知道，在社区里做志愿者。

sentences.en: They gave what they could.
sentences.zh: 他们尽其所能地捐助。

sentences.en: And then as my mom saw—
sentences.zh: 然后当我妈妈看到——

sentences.en: She was big in the United Way, yes?
sentences.zh: 她在联合劝募会（United Way）里扮演了重要角色，对吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确切地说。

sentences.en: She put a lot of her time into that, both in our city but also at the federal level.
sentences.zh: 她把大量时间投入其中，不仅在我们城市，还在联邦层面。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So she was always telling me, okay, you know, you've got to run a United Way campaign and give back.
sentences.zh: 所以她总是告诉我，好了，你知道，你得去领导一个联合劝募会活动并回馈社会。

sentences.en: Sadly, she died pretty young, about 30 years ago.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，她去世得很早，大约30年前。

sentences.en: And it was my dad who actually, when I was still full-time at Microsoft,
sentences.zh: 当我还在微软全职工作时，实际上是我爸爸，

sentences.en: ran the foundation and got it going for the first 10 years and kind of set the culture in a very positive way.
sentences.zh: 运营了基金会并在头10年将其运转起来，以非常积极的方式奠定了文化。

sentences.en: So he did get to see and participate in, you know, all those dictates that go back to my childhood.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实见证并参与了，你知道，所有那些可以追溯到我童年的指令。

sentences.en: Are your kids being as observational as you were and benefiting from it like you did?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子也像你一样善于观察并从中受益吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: Well, my kids, you know, are both lucky, although being a child of somebody well-known, you know, I'm sure your kids experience some of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的孩子们，你知道，都挺幸运的，虽然作为知名人士的孩子，你知道，我敢肯定你的孩子也经历过一些这样的情况。

sentences.en: It's got a lot of pluses but some minuses as well.
sentences.zh: 有利也有弊。

sentences.en: But are they following your great example, I guess, is my question.
sentences.zh: 不过我的问题是，他们有在效仿你的好榜样吗？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I'm giving them as a percentage of the wealth a pretty small percentage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我留给他们的财富比例其实非常小。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, in absolute, it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，绝对值其实很大。

sentences.en: And I do believe that, you know, they'll have their own careers and they'll be very generous with what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信，你知道，他们会拥有自己的职业生涯，并且会对他们的所作所为非常慷慨。

sentences.en: But I didn't decide that we would take, you know, that wealth and pass it down.
sentences.zh: 但我没有决定要把那些财富传给他们。

sentences.en: You know, 95% goes out through the foundation.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，95% 都通过基金会捐出去了。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, I'm super happy with how hard they work and their values.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道，我对他们工作有多努力以及他们的价值观感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: You know, my wife, Melinda, did a great job raising the kids and it's worked out well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的妻子梅琳达在抚养孩子方面做得非常棒，结果很好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: What about, I want to know, like, about that gut probe in a pill.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我想了解一下，比如那个药丸里的肠道探针。

sentences.en: Like, you just eat a pill.
sentences.zh: 就像，你只要吃下一粒药丸。

sentences.en: Like, describe that to me because I just read headlines about it.
sentences.zh: 能不能给我描述一下，因为我只读过相关的标题。

sentences.en: I didn't really know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 其实我并不是很了解。

sentences.en: What is that technology and what is it used for?
sentences.zh: 那是什么技术，有什么用？

sentences.en: Probe in a pill.
sentences.zh: 药丸里的探针。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like, you eat a pill and it probes your guts.
sentences.zh: 就像，你吃下一粒药丸，它就能探测你的肠道。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, digestion is super complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以，消化系统超级复杂。

sentences.en: And that's why these nutritional fads come along.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么各种营养时尚层出不穷。

sentences.en: And the New Yorker cartoon said, you better adopt this new nutritional fad quickly before they prove it doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 正如《纽约客》漫画所说，在他们证明这种营养时尚无效之前，你最好赶紧接受它。

sentences.en: And what happens is that in your gut, there's a lot of bacteria they call the microbiome.
sentences.zh: 情况是这样的，你的肠道里有大量被称为微生物组的细菌。

sentences.en: And we're just now, as you swallow this capsule and it absorbs all of those bacteria, we see what's going on.
sentences.zh: 当我们吞下这个胶囊，它吸收所有这些细菌时，我们就能看到发生了什么。

sentences.en: We finally understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我们终于理解到底是怎么回事了。

sentences.en: And so, our foundation works on malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的基金会致力于解决营养不良问题。

sentences.en: These big pharmaceutical companies like Eli Lilly work on overnutrition.
sentences.zh: 像礼来这样的各大制药公司则致力于解决营养过剩问题。

sentences.en: And it turns out that we work together on the research because the same complex circuitry that allows poor kids to be malnourished.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我们在研究上进行合作，因为导致贫困儿童营养不良的复杂机制是相同的。

sentences.en: In the U.S., we have, you know, horrible levels of childhood obesity.
sentences.zh: 在美国，你知道，我们的儿童肥胖率达到了可怕的水平。

sentences.en: And so, as we're learning that, you know, new drugs like these GLP-1 obesity drugs that, as they get cheaper, are going to have a profound effect.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着我们的了解，你知道，像这些 GLP-1 减肥药这样的新药，随着它们价格下降，将产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, that's the type of innovation coming out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是正在涌现的创新类型。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, we didn't understand that until very recently.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道，直到最近我们才明白这一点。

sentences.en: Well, but we had, and Sean's still mourning the, you know, the new ban on red dye number three because it's such a staple in his diet, as you can probably tell.
sentences.zh: 好吧，不过我们有，而且肖恩还在为那项关于禁止红色的禁令哀悼，你知道的，红3号，因为正如你所能看出的那样，这是他饮食中的主食。

sentences.en: He can't identify the cherry and the strawberry flavor and stuff.

sentences.en: His brain is basically liquefied.
sentences.zh: 他的大脑基本上已经液化了。

sentences.en: But I will say, you know, you talk about that in this, about obesity and childhood obesity.
sentences.zh: 不过我要说的是，你知道，你在此谈到了肥胖和儿童肥胖问题。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: What is the difference in this country?
sentences.zh: 这个国家有什么不同？

sentences.en: Again, it sounds like I've been attacking this country.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，听起来我好像在攻击这个国家。

sentences.en: I'm really not.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有。

sentences.en: I just, I'm curious about things like, about childhood obesity compared to other countries and the nutrition and things that are allowed.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我对诸如与其他国家相比的儿童肥胖、营养以及允许使用的成分之类的事情感到好奇。

sentences.en: Like, you know, you've seen those things where they compare a product that is the same, but that's sold here and then sold in the U.K.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，你见过那种比较，对比一种完全相同的产品的成分，一种是在这里销售，另一种是在英国销售。

sentences.en: And the list of ingredients is like double in this country with additives and preservers, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，配料表里的添加剂和防腐剂等东西几乎多了一倍。

sentences.en: I mean, is that a massive problem or no?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个巨大的问题吗？

sentences.en: Almost certainly not.
sentences.zh: 几乎完全不可能。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, our kids sit in front of the TV more than any other kids.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，我们的孩子看电视的时间比其他任何国家的孩子都多。

sentences.en: So lack of activity alone explains most of this.
sentences.zh: 所以仅仅是缺乏活动就解释了大部分原因。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And, you know, sadly, when your parents are obese, the likelihood that you'll be obese goes up pretty dramatically.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，可悲的是，当你的父母肥胖时，你肥胖的可能性会显著增加。

sentences.en: And so the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以美国——

sentences.en: in many respects, drug addiction, obesity, we're, you could say, as the world's richest country, all the problems of being rich are worse in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，毒品上瘾、肥胖，我们可以这么说，作为世界上最富有的国家，富裕带来的所有问题在美国都比在其他任何地方都要严重。

sentences.en: than they are anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 比其他任何地方都严重。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: We're also the most innovative, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们也是最具创新精神的。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's why I'm not a pessimist at all.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是为什么我一点也不悲观。

sentences.en: I do think—
sentences.zh: 我确实认为——

sentences.en: Wait, so it's just apathy?
sentences.zh: 等等，所以这只是冷漠吗？

sentences.en: Is that what it is?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: No, your TV shows are too entertaining.
sentences.zh: 不，是你们的电视节目太好看了。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: It's all your fault.
sentences.zh: 这全都是你的错。

sentences.en: Not mine.
sentences.zh: 不是我的。

sentences.en: Not mine.
sentences.zh: 不是我的。

sentences.en: What are you excited for?
sentences.zh: 你对什么感到兴奋？

sentences.en: What are you excited for the next five years?
sentences.zh: 对于接下来的五年，你对什么感到兴奋？

sentences.en: Sorry, Sean.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，肖恩。

sentences.en: No, that's good.
sentences.zh: 不，这很好。

sentences.en: I just had one question about another issue.
sentences.zh: 我只是对另一个问题有一个疑问。

sentences.en: But, yeah, sorry.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，抱歉。

sentences.en: Well, right before that, but I do want to get to that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在那之前，但我确实想谈谈那个。

sentences.en: I'm really passionate about this because of the fires that just happened, because of the constant droughts in California.
sentences.zh: 我对这个充满热情，因为刚刚发生的大火，因为加州持续的干旱。

sentences.en: And we talked to Kamala Harris about this like three, four years ago when she was the senator in California, is like most of the earth is water.
sentences.zh: 我们三、四年前和卡玛拉·哈里斯谈过这个，当时她是加州的参议员，就像地球大部分都是水一样。

sentences.en: And so when there's a shortage of water, I'm like, how can we not figure out how to desalinate water?
sentences.zh: 所以当水资源短缺时，我在想，我们怎么就想不出怎么给水淡化呢？

sentences.en: And people say it's too expensive.
sentences.zh: 人们说这太贵了。

sentences.en: Well, it's more expensive to not figure it out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，想不出办法来解决才更贵。

sentences.en: And so what are your thoughts about that?
sentences.zh: 那么你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: And do you have any kind of desire to be in that world?
sentences.zh: 你有没有什么愿望想涉足那个领域？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm very involved in that because, you know, we have to both do climate mitigation and climate adaptation.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我深度参与其中，因为你知道，我们既要做气候减缓，又要做气候适应。

sentences.en: And adaptation, a part of that is dealing with water shortages and more difficult weather.
sentences.zh: 而适应其中的一部分就是应对水资源短缺和更极端的天气。

sentences.en: It takes a certain amount of energy to desalinate water.
sentences.zh: 海水淡化需要消耗一定量的能量。

sentences.en: And so only by bringing the cost of energy down with things like solar or perhaps nuclear fission or fusion, then you get more water availability.
sentences.zh: 因此，只有通过利用太阳能或核裂变、核聚变等技术降低能源成本，才能获得更多的水资源。

sentences.en: 80% of water is used for agriculture.
sentences.zh: 80%的水用于农业。

sentences.en: So you can afford to desalinate water for human consumption.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以承担得起为了人类消费而进行海水淡化的费用。

sentences.en: You can't really afford to do it for agriculture.
sentences.zh: 你其实承担不起把它用于农业的费用。

sentences.en: So you have to end up moving your farms to the places where there's enough water.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终不得不把农场搬到水资源充足的地方去。

sentences.en: You don't want to pay to desalinate just to grow.
sentences.zh: 你不想为了种植作物而花钱淡化海水。

sentences.en: Unless you do.
sentences.zh: 除非你这么做。

sentences.en: Unless we figure out a way to do it.
sentences.zh: 除非我们找到办法做到这一点。

sentences.en: Unless you do.
sentences.zh: 除非你这么做。

sentences.en: And people like, you know, sadly, Jason Bateman, who, you know, obviously with his almond consumption has been destroying the planet.
sentences.zh: 还有像，你知道的，可悲的是，杰森·贝特曼，你知道的，显然他消耗杏仁的行为一直在破坏地球。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable the amount of water that goes to every one of your precious almonds that you just carelessly stuff in your mouth.
sentences.zh: 难以置信，你随随便便塞进嘴里的每一颗珍贵杏仁背后，都消耗了那么多的水。

sentences.en: But, Bill, what is that?
sentences.zh: 但是，比尔，那是什么？

sentences.en: I was going to ask you what you're excited about the next five years.
sentences.zh: 我本来想问你对未来五年有什么期待。

sentences.en: What are we going to do about energy sources going forward?
sentences.zh: 未来我们在能源供应方面该怎么办？

sentences.en: What can we do?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么？

sentences.en: Have we reached peak oil?
sentences.zh: 我们已经到达石油峰值了吗？

sentences.en: What are we going to do with fossil fuels?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何处理化石燃料？

sentences.en: Can we keep it going in this direction?
sentences.zh: 我们还能沿着这个方向继续下去吗？

sentences.en: What do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, I'm very hopeful that between expanding wind and solar and getting both types of nuclear, nuclear fission and fusion,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常希望通过扩大风能和太阳能，并发展核裂变和核聚变这两种核能，

sentences.en: to get safer and cheaper, that even with all this demand for energy, like electric cars or electric heat pumps, AI data centers,
sentences.zh: 使其更安全、更便宜，这样即使面对所有这些能源需求——比如电动汽车、电热泵、AI数据中心——

sentences.en: that we'll be able to get ahead of that and still have cheap electricity, even though we'll get rid of all of the terrible CO2 emissions.
sentences.zh: 我们也能够应付自如，依然拥有廉价的电力，同时还能摆脱所有可怕的二氧化碳排放。

sentences.en: So, we are going to have to transition away from coal and natural gas in the decades ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以，在未来的几十年里，我们必须过渡到摆脱煤炭和天然气。

sentences.en: I mean, and that's going to be a painful transition, I imagine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可以想象，这将是一个痛苦的过渡。

sentences.en: Not if we innovate the cost of these other things down.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能通过创新把这些替代技术的成本降下来，就不会痛苦。

sentences.en: You know, electric cars are getting cheaper.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，电动汽车正在变得越来越便宜。

sentences.en: Eventually, you do get to the point where the substitute is as cheap as the dirty thing was.
sentences.zh: 最终，你会发现替代品的成本会变得和以前污染严重的传统能源一样便宜。

sentences.en: And in the long run, that's what we need to do so that we get global adoption of green approaches.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这正是我们需要做的，以便让全球都采纳绿色环保方案。

sentences.en: Well, but educate me, if you would, to the extent that you know.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你了解的话，请给我科普一下。

sentences.en: You know, if you get an electric car and you get all these people who get them and they're great,
sentences.zh: 你看，如果你买了一辆电动汽车，而且很多人都买了并且觉得很好，

sentences.en: and then some people like to virtue signal with them and shame other people.
sentences.zh: 然后有些人喜欢用它来标榜道德并以此羞辱其他人。

sentences.en: But the components, so many of the components that go into the car are, you know, petroleum-based,
sentences.zh: 但是汽车的很多零部件，你知道的，都是石油基的，

sentences.en: whether it's the actual components themselves or traveling those cars to their destinations or across oceans and stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 无论是零部件本身，还是把这些汽车运送到目的地或跨越大洋之类的，对吧？

sentences.en: You know about all this.
sentences.zh: 这些你都知道。

sentences.en: So, it's all, is there any way that we can mitigate all of those other things as well
sentences.zh: 所以，有没有什么办法能把所有这些其他方面的因素也减少，

sentences.en: so that we're not relying on petroleum for everything?
sentences.zh: 这样我们就不会事事都依赖石油了？

sentences.en: You know, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: And we measure that.
sentences.zh: 而且我们一直在对此进行评估。

sentences.en: You know, anybody who buys an electric car, as you say, it's not zero emissions,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，正如你所说，任何人买电动汽车，虽然不能做到零排放，

sentences.en: but it is dramatically less than a gasoline car.
sentences.zh: 但它比汽油车要少得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we're learning to make the batteries using less energy and less environmental things,
sentences.zh: 而且我们正在学习用更少的能量和对环境更少影响的方式来制造电池，

sentences.en: like new ways of finding lithium.
sentences.zh: 比如寻找锂的新方法。

sentences.en: And so, the accounting on, okay, you know, how do we have the most environmentally clean car,
sentences.zh: 所以，关于如何制造出对环境最清洁的汽车这类账目，

sentences.en: we're doing a very good job tracking that.
sentences.zh: 我们在这方面的追踪工作做得非常好。

sentences.en: And consumers who help create demand for electric vehicles,
sentences.zh: 那些帮助创造电动汽车需求的消费者，

sentences.en: they deserve a little bit, a sense of virtue because they are, the more we buy,
sentences.zh: 他们确实值得有一点优越感，因为他们……我们买得越多，

sentences.en: the more the price goes down and the more we...
sentences.zh: 价格就会越低，我们就会……

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I was playing, obviously, but I do agree.
sentences.zh: 我刚才显然是在开玩笑，但我确实同意。

sentences.en: I do agree.
sentences.zh: 我确实同意。

sentences.en: Bill, what's the rest of your day look like?
sentences.zh: 比尔，你接下来的日程安排是怎样的？

sentences.en: What are your...
sentences.zh: 你的……

sentences.en: Is your average day...
sentences.zh: 你平常的一天……

sentences.zh: 我要解雇那个叫他这么做的人。

sentences.en: Is your average day split 50-50 between sort of personal pleasure, silly stuff,
sentences.zh: 你平常的一天是不是有一半时间用来享受个人乐趣、做点傻事，

sentences.en: and also saving the world with the other half?
sentences.zh: 另一半时间用来拯救世界？

sentences.en: Or I'll bet the ratio is not 50-50.
sentences.zh: 或者我敢说比例根本不是五五开。

sentences.zh: 如果有的话，那是什么？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.zh: 在我二十多岁的时候，我对工作简直是狂热痴迷。

sentences.en: But now, although I work, you know, 50 hours of work a week and travel a lot,
sentences.zh: 但现在，虽然我每周工作，你知道，大约50个小时，而且经常出差，

sentences.en: I play a fair bit of tennis.
sentences.zh: 我还是会打挺多网球。

sentences.zh: 我经常玩匹克球。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢阅读。

sentences.en: I love, you know, TV shows that you guys have made.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢，你知道的，你们制作的那些电视剧。

sentences.en: That's super fun.
sentences.zh: 真的超级有意思。

sentences.en: A little bit of golf?
sentences.zh: 会打一点高尔夫吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm not doing much golf.
sentences.zh: 不，我不太怎么打高尔夫。

sentences.en: I like tennis and pickleball because slightly better exercise.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢网球和匹克球，因为它们的运动量稍微好一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure, sure.
sentences.zh: 对，当然，当然。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: What is the one thing that you know how to do that everyone would be kind of surprised about?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪件事是你擅长做，但大家会觉得挺意外的？

sentences.en: Do you have like a little hobby?
sentences.zh: 你有什么小爱好吗？

sentences.en: Like, are you a great, like, drawer?
sentences.zh: 比如说，你很会画画什么的吗？

sentences.en: Do you cook?
sentences.zh: 你会做饭吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, like, are you a knitter?
sentences.zh: 对，比如，你是个织毛衣高手吗？

sentences.en: Is there anything that's sort of a sneaky little talent that people might be surprised about?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么可以说是暗藏的小才华，会让大家感到意外的？

sentences.en: Like, are you a great whistler, you know?
sentences.zh: 比如说，你很会吹口哨之类的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, nice.
sentences.zh: 对，不错。

sentences.zh: 这挺厉害的。

sentences.zh: 这算数。

sentences.zh: 说来就来，说来就来，还不错。

sentences.zh: 我很擅长在飞机上睡觉。

sentences.zh: 哦，那可真是个了不起的才华。

sentences.zh: 那绝对是个了不起的才华。

sentences.zh: 话说回来，你喜欢咸的还是甜的？

sentences.en: Do you have a sweet tooth?
sentences.zh: 你爱吃甜食吗？

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 不，我尽量不在身边放太多花生脆糖，因为只要身边有什么我都会吃光。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.zh: 嗯，你没有被那些无聊的事情分心真是太好了，因为我们需要你在岗位上做好你一直在做的事，并且我们希望你以后能继续做下去。

sentences.zh: 所以，非常感谢你过去所做的一切，以及你将要做的事，也谢谢你花了一个小时的时间陪伴我们。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 真有意思。
